commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+6' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
90+4' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Stanko Juric (Valladolid) for a tough tackle.

90+3' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
90+2' Paulo Pezzolano prepares a substitution. Selim Amallah is replaced by Chuki (Valladolid).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
88' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) fires the resultant free kick towards the left post, but the keeper makes a brilliant save and denies him the chance to score.

87' Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alejandro Quintero stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Leganes win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Leganes comes to nothing.

85' Roberto Lopez (Leganes) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Leganes.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Renato Tapia (Leganes) is replacing Yvan Neyou.
83' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Alejandro Quintero lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
83' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
82' It's a free kick to Valladolid, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
82' The foul by Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alejandro Quintero.
82' Luis Perez (Valladolid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
81' Raul Moro is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Marcos Andre (Valladolid).
80' Raul Moro (Valladolid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

79' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
79' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
78' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
75' Valladolid restart play with a quick free kick.
74' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Quintero signals. A free kick has been awarded to Valladolid.
73' PENALTY APPEAL after Selim Amallah (Valladolid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
73' A cross from Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
71' The substitution has been made. Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) has replaced Julian Chicco.

71' Raul Moro plays a short pass through to Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
70' Raul Moro (Valladolid) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
69' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
68' Raul Moro (Valladolid) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
66' Here comes a substitution. Seydouba Cisse is given a rest as he is replaced by Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
66' Here is a change. Juan Cruz is going off and Borja Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Roberto Lopez (Leganes).
64' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Juan Soriano, who smothers the ball.
64' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
62' Kike Perez goes off the pitch and Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) comes on.
62' Paulo Pezzolano decides to make a substitution. Amath Ndiaye will be replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
62' Substitution. Mamadou Sylla makes way for Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).
61' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
60' Juan Cruz (Leganes) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
59' It looks like Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Quintero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
56' A player from Leganes commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
56' The linesman points to the corner flag, Leganes are going to take it.

55' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Juan Cruz is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him.
54' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
54' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick.

52' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Juan Soriano pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
50' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
50' The attendance is 21764.
48' Alejandro Quintero blows the whistle, Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) is penalised for a foul.
47' Valladolid take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
47' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Valladolid have a free kick.
46' A yellow card for a tackle by Yvan Neyou (Leganes). Alejandro Quintero doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' Borja Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Oscar Rodriguez comes on the pitch for Enric Franquesa (Leganes).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' The resulting corner from Raul Moro (Valladolid) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+3' A terrific piece of skill by Raul Moro (Valladolid) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten. The referee signals a corner kick to Valladolid.
45+2' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' Referee Alejandro Quintero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Paulo Pezzolano, then shows him a yellow.
45+1' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Flavien Boyomo (Valladolid) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Quintero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
42' The ball goes behind for a corner. Valladolid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' Luis Perez (Valladolid) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.

41' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is behind the touchline and Leganes will take a throw-in.

39' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Juan Soriano is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
38' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Raul Moro (Valladolid) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
36' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul. A free kick to Leganes.
34' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
34' Raul Moro (Valladolid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
28' Raul Moro (Valladolid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
27' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle after Javi Hernandez (Leganes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
26' Juan Cruz (Leganes) tries to find Valentin Rosier, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
26' Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

25' Juan Cruz (Leganes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Quintero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
23' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
23' The ball is out of play. Leganes will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
18' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
17' Today's referee Alejandro Quintero rightly decides to book Enric Franquesa (Leganes) for his harsh tackle.
16' The resulting corner from Kike Perez (Valladolid) comes to nothing.
15' An attempted cross from Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) is cleared. Good work from Valladolid as they win a corner.

14' Kike Perez (Valladolid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
13' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Quintero interrupts the game. Valladolid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
12' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
10' The ball possession is 61:39.
7' The move breaks down when Yvan Neyou (Leganes) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
4' Juan Cruz (Leganes) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
3' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

3' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Leganes will have an opportunity.

2' A rebound falls to Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
1' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Kike Perez (Valladolid) inside the box.
